query:
UPDATE outbox
           SET attempts = attempts + 1,
               last_error = left($2, 2000),
               next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $3::int),
               dead_at = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= $4 THEN now() ELSE NULL END
           WHERE id = $1
           RETURNING dead_at IS NOT NULL AS "dead!"
